crossRefs.note: “Therefore Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘I said indeed that your house and the house of your father should walk…
“Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.
If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there my servant will also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will…
What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not…
